items.text: We would like to provide details for an upcoming game update.
Added support for paid downloadable content.
Added support for the “SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE - Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Pack”.
The following unit, character, expansion parts, CAPITAL tickets, level uncap materials and GM (Gatheroad) Gundam game collaboration BGM will be available for users that purchase this DLC.
Additional Playable Unit: Gundam Aerial
Additional Character: Suletta Mercury
Three types of additional expansion parts:
The emblem of the Holder (Infighters, All-Rounders and Sharpshooters)
Effect: Aerial Damage +8％ / Sidestep Invulnerability Time +0.02S / [Main Ranged and Subweapons] Reload+5％
Miorine's Tomato
Effect : Melee +150 / [beam type] Melee Attack +20％ / [All Attacks] Stagger Effect +20％
Effect [All-Rounder]: Melee +100 / Ranged +100 / [All Attacks] Stagger Effect +20％
Effect : Ranged +150 / [beam type] Ranged Attack +20％ / [All Attacks] Stagger Effect +20％
“GUND-ARM Inc. Clip” Expansion Part (Infighters, All-Rounders and Sharpshooters)
Effect: Dropped Capital +2500 / Full MS Repair Kit +15％ / Hate +100％
Additional CAPITAL Tickets: 100,000 CAPITAL tickets x3
Additional Level Uncap Materials:
1st Level Uncap Materials: (Infighters, All-Rounders, and Sharpshooters) ×3
2nd Level Uncap Materials: (Infighters, All-Rounders, and Sharpshooters) ×4
GM (Gatheroad) Gundam Game Collaboration BGM:
CALM - MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION 2
EMERGENCY - MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM BATTLE OPERATION 2
Battle IV - MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM U.C. ENGAGE
A New Encounter I - MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM U.C. ENGAGE
The “SD GUNDAM BATTLE ALLIANCE - Mobile Suit Gundam: The Witch from Mercury Pack” paid DLC will be available on May 11th, 2023.
Please note that there will no additional missions.
Fixed an issue which caused the third attack from Gundam Astray Red Frame Kai’s SPA to miss when performed in the air.
Fixed an issue which caused the final attack from Gundam Kimaris Vidar’s SPA to miss when performed in the air.
Fixed an issue which caused Gundam Barbatos Lupus Rex’s counter to miss when used against certain attacks.

Fixed an issue which prevented SPA recast speedup bonuses to be received when using subweapons with the following units: Destiny Gundam / Gelgoog (Char) / Gouf Custom / Justice Gundam / Infinite Justice Gundam / The-O / Turn A Gundam

Fixed an issue which prevented expansion part effects to not trigger when the following units use a ranged weapon and then perform other attacks before the ranged weapon attack hits the enemy: Gelgoog (Char) / Qubeley / Nu Gundam / Sazabi / Hi-Nu Gundam / Kshatriya / Penelope / Providence Gundam / Strike Freedom Gundam / Cherudim Gundam / Arche Gundam / Reborns Gundam / 00 QAN / Phoenix Gundam

Fixed an issue in multiplayer which caused equipped expansion parts with “Perfect Guard Skill Meter Recovery” effects to not trigger for the guest even after a perfect guard is performed against a ranged attack.
Fixed an issue which caused an event that doesn’t usually occur in multiplayer to trigger when the host player selects “Gundam” as a partner and plays the “Hero of Lacroa“ mission in multiplayer.
Fixed an issue which caused some dialogue to not be displayed in the “Seen and Unseen“ mission after “Apsaras III” appears.
We apologize for the length of time required to release this game update. Thank you for your continued support of "SD Gundam Battle Alliance".

notes.title: ▼Release Timing for the game update ver. 1.31

items.text: November 30, 2022 (Wednesday)
• The amount of damage to the balancer gauge of Justice Gundam Subweapon 1 Bassel Beam Boomerang for was less than expected, so the amount of damage has been increased.
• When Gundam Gusion Rebake Full City’s Subweapon 2 110mm Rifle (simultaneous fire) hits an enemy in the air, it now always cause a knockdown if the balancer gauge is zero
• Fixed an issue where Legendary Gundam’s Special Attack would sometimes would not hit an enemy
• Fixed an issue where Knight Superior Dragon’s attack Golden Dragon Bow would not damage the balancer meter when hitting an airborne enemy
• Fixed an issue where Moon Gundam’s Subweapon1 Psycho Plate (Shield) balancer meter damage was different depending on whether the enemy was on the ground or airbourne, they should now be equal
• Fixed an issue in which Xi Gundam’s counter-attacks against Zeong’s melee attacks were not connecting
• Fixed an issue in which Penelope’s Subweapon 2 Funnel Missel would disappear and cause its special attack to be unresponsive
• The following units have had their air damage adjusted
Increased the amount of damage when the aerial special attack of Hi-Nu Gundam hits in mid-air.
Increased the amount of damage when the Crossbone Gundam X2’s Subweapon2 Shot Lancer (Rush) hits in the air.
Increased the amount of damage when the Arios Gundam's ground Subweapon 1 GN Submachine Gun hits in the air.
Increased the amount of damage when the aerial special attack of Gundam Kimaris Vidar hits in the air.
Increased the amount of damage when the aerial special attack of Gundam Latreia hits in the air.
Increased the amount of damage when the Phoenix Gundam's Subweapon 2 "Mega Beam Cannon" hits in mid-air.

・In the DLC mission "Destination of the Legend," when a specific enemy ace unit that appears at a high altitude was immediately destroyed, drops were placed in areas inaccessible to the player, this has been corrected

notes.title: ▼Release Timing for the STEAM Version Game Update

items.text: Wednesday, September 21st, 2022

Unlock High Levels of Mobile Suits: MS level 100: Pilot Level 100: Partner Pilot level 100: *Uncapping materials is required to raise the MS level to 91 or higher.: -Provide additional capital ticket for “1,000,000 capital”: 50,000 CAPITAL x 20
Added Ex. Part - Chobham Armor: Chobham Armor / Chobham Armor [All-Rounder] / Chobham Armor: Effect: HP: Power up +120 / Counter: Locked / All Melee Boost Consumption: Increased +20%

Free missions "EX Missions" have been added.: EX Mission 04, EX Mission 05, and EX Mission 06: *These are challenging missions that can be played after clearing all Hard Mode missions except for Chaos Missions.

The paid DLC mission “Knights of Moon & Light " is now supported.: The following missions will be playable if you have purchased DLC Pack 2.: “Hero of Lacroa", " Evil God of the Moon ", "EX Mission Extreme 3", and "EX Mission Extreme 4".: * Unit and Scenario pack 2 “Knight of Moon & Light” is scheduled for release on September 29th.: *Please note that in order to play "EX Mission Extreme 3" and "EX Mission Extreme 4," you will need to complete the " Hero of Lacroa" and “Evil God of the Moon " missions in addition to the free EX Missions.
The following settings can be selected on in [Create Room] [Room Search]: [Download Content Only] / [Hard Mission Only] / [EX Mission Only]

Drop adjustment of blueprints: Certain blueprints for the "Cursed Treasure" and "Mythical Destination" missions have been adjusted to have a "probability" of dropping additional blueprints.: A game update has been released to address the above issues. We apologize for the inconvenience caused and thank you for your patience.: If the game update is not reflected, please restart the STEAM client.: We apologize for any inconvenience these issues may have caused and ask that you kindly wait for the updates to be released.: Thank you for your continued support of "SD Gundam Battle Alliance”.: https://store.steampowered.com/app/824550/SD_GUNDAM_BATTLE_ALLIANCE/

items.text: Thursday, September 1st, 2022
Fixed an issue which caused the message, ”This game is shutting down as it was: opened in an unsupported OS.” to be displayed and prevented the application from starting.
Fixed multiple display-related issues.

Fixed SPA (Special Attacks) animations.

Fixed an issue which caused songs to not play when changing music in the Library or selecting BGM for SPAs after clearing a mission.
Fixed an issue which caused incorrect BGM to be selected when selecting BGM for SPAs (Special Attacks).
Fixed an issue which caused songs to overlap during playback under certain conditions.
Fixed some character graphic display issues that were present in the game’s story.
Adjusted the volume for some songs.
Adjusted attack actions for some playable units.
Adjust some of the AI for partners and enemy units.
Fixed issues which caused some enemy attacks to be difficult to see.

releases.displayName: [Important Notice] Known Issues in "SD Gundam Battle Alliance"

items.text: We have read the various comments and requests from our customers and will consider addressing them in future updates.
●The message, ”This game is shutting down as it was opened in an unsupported OS.” is displayed and the application cannot be started.
We are currently investigating this issue.: ●Gameplay feels heavy/slow even though the required PC specs have been met.

We are currently investigating whether this can be improved in a future update.: ●After configuring the “Edit Music” setting, the music set does not play.: In addition, songs are overlapped during playback or the music just stops.

We are currently working on a fix. Improvements will be made in a future update.: Please try restarting the application or reconfiguring the music to resolve the issue.: ●Improvements to keyboard and mouse controls
We are currently investigating whether the controls can be improved in a future update.: ●Support for mouse side buttons

We are currently investigating whether this can be improved in a future update.: ●When “Display Mode” is set to "Borderless Windowed", the screen is displayed in desktop resolution instead of the actual screen resolution that is set.
Improvements will be made in a future update.: ●When using a 4:3 aspect ratio monitor (resolution: 1280x960), the screen display is stretched.
Improvements will be made in a future update.: ●“Anti-Aliasing", "Texture Filter", and "Shadows" settings are not reflected in the game.

Improvements will be made in a future update.: ●When the room host is confirming enemy MS/MA appearance on the multiplayer mission selection screen, if another player who has not unlocked the mission enters the room, the host will temporarily lose control of the game.

Improvements will be made in a future update.: ●In Multiplayer, when the room host is confirming enemy MS/MA appearance on the "Select Mode/Difficulty" screen, if another player who has not unlocked the mission enters the room, the host will lose control of the game.

Improvements will be made in a future update.: ●When trying to enter a room after receiving an invite, an error message is not displayed and the screen turns black if the room has already been closed.
Improvements will be made in a future update.: In addition to the above, we plan to make improvements and address issues in future updates.
We are currently working on updates to address the current known issues. We will announce the release schedule for the updates once it has been determined.
